## If this is a calculation bug, include the exact input

This is the most important part of the report.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tool** | <!-- e.g. Loan, Percentage, Calculus → Integral --> |
| **Field values** | <!-- Exactly what you typed, and the units you selected --> |
| **Units selected** | <!-- if the tool has a unit picker --> |
| **Result shown** | <!-- copy it from the app --> |
| **Result expected** | <!-- and say where your expected value comes from --> |

```
Example:

Tool:       Loan
Principal:  250000
Rate:       4.5 %
Term:       30 years
Payments:   monthly

Shown:      1265.85
Expected:   1265.84  (my bank quotes this)
```
